data.name: Kalanvansh
data.long_meaning: The name Kalanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning ‘Time’ and ‘Vansh’ meaning ‘Descendants’ or ‘Lineage’. This name signifies someone who belongs to the lineage of Kala, a significant deity in Hindu mythology. In Hindu tradition, Kala is often depicted as the God of Time and Destiny, and is believed to control the cosmic cycle of creation and destruction.
